question: which parts of the production entry chain depend on the 2L/2R (2-left/2-right) pivots

DIRECT_2L2R_DEPENDENCY.evidence: liquidity/productionEqualLiquidityV1.js buildEvent() writes metadata.currentPivot = { source: 'ORDINARY_CAUSAL_2X2', price: pivot.price, occurredAt, confirmedAt, sourceIndex }; the pivot is produced by structure/pivotDetector.js via replay/replayState.js incrementalLiquidity
EQ.occurredAt = pivot occurredAt, EQ.createdAt = EQ.confirmedAt = pivot.confirmedAt (productionEqualLiquidityV1.js:194-198); pivotKey() is built from the pivot fields
buildEvent(): price: pivot.price, and the tolerance comparison Math.abs(pivot.price - anchor.price)
execution/executionRulesV1.js buildEntryPlan line 183 passes base.eqPrice as rawStop, and base.eqPrice comes from event.eqSourceContext.currentPivot.price (line 145-146) - i.e. the 2/2 pivot wick
eqOccurredAt / eqConfirmedAt / eqCurrentPoint all read from eqSourceContext.currentPivot (lines 147-150)
realOrderExecutionV1.js onConfirmedSwings() cancels a resting entry when a new SWING_LOW (long) / SWING_HIGH (short) confirms after decisionTime; those swings are the 2/2 pivots

DIRECT_2L2R_DEPENDENCY.component: swing registry used by structural provenance
DIRECT_2L2R_DEPENDENCY.evidence: replayState.incrementalLiquidity lines 131-143 add the swing-liquidity objects to state.registry and return newConfirmedSwings to live.js

INDIRECT_2L2R_DEPENDENCY.evidence: a WATCH is built only from a newly confirmed EQ event, so its existence and openedAt inherit the 2/2 confirmation time (eqFvgCountWatchV1.js buildWatch: openedAt = liquidity.confirmedAt)
the FVG counter only starts consuming raw FVGs with confirmedAt >= watch.openedAt, so the 2/2 confirmation time delays the earliest possible entry trigger
realOrderExecutionV1.tradeIdFor(event) and the semantic decision key both include event.liquidityId / event.watchId, which embed the EQ id derived from the pivot

INDEPENDENT_OF_2L2R.evidence: buildEntryPlan line 134: rawEntry = (rawFvg.low + rawFvg.high) / 2 - the FVG midpoint only
live/eqFvgCountWatchV1.js rawFvgAt uses only candles[index-2] and candles[index]
executionRulesV1.selectTarget iterates context.dynamicDPoints, i.e. Causal Dynamic-D historical points, not pivots
executionRulesV1.biasGate only reads the 4H bias snapshot
executionRulesV1.sizeOrder uses only entry/stop/target plus exchangeInfo rules
realOrderExecutionV1 / binanceExecutionClientV1 use only the plan

live/eqFvgAssociationSemanticV1.js consumes the EQ event, the raw FVG and engine state; its facts never read a pivot. Defaults are enabled=true, liveGateEnabled=true, failClosed=true, requiredConfidence=HIGH (config/eqFvgSemanticV1.js)
structure/structuralProvenance5m.js is fed by newConfirmedSwings and writes event-registry events; it does not gate Current Point, EQ, WATCH, entry plan, SL or TP
productionEqualLiquidityV1.eligibleHistoricalPoints filters the HISTORICAL partner side only; buildEntryPlan lines 151-153 state the current point is deliberately not significance filtered
